# Terraform / IaC buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then discarded.
# One-time structural checks for the native command surface, state policy, and
# environment isolation; ongoing IaC judgment lives in languages/terraform.llmlint.yml.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: iac_command_surface_wired
    description: |
      true when the root recipes delegate to the orchestrator and the projects'
      targets use the Terraform/OpenTofu-native lifecycle: `bootstrap`
      initializes the backend in each root module; `check` runs format-check,
      validation, tflint, and a security scan per project; and `upgrade`
      deliberately updates provider and module constraints plus each root
      module's lock file before re-running the gate and reviewing a plan. false
      when the surface omits a stage, hand-rolls a per-directory loop instead of
      delegating, applies changes from the check recipe, or updates dependencies
      without an explicit review step.
    files:
      include: ["justfile", "Justfile", ".justfile", ".github/workflows/**", "nx.json", "**/project.json"]
    relevance: the target files define or invoke the repository command surface for infrastructure work

  - name: remote_state_policy_wired
    description: |
      true when the repository wires a remote state design with locking, encryption,
      access control, recovery, and clear ownership appropriate to its platform,
      while ignore policy excludes local state artifacts and `.terraform/`. false
      when backend configuration is merely present but its concurrency, sensitivity,
      recovery, or ownership model is incomplete or dependent on a developer machine.
    files:
      include: ["**/*.tf", "**/*.tf.json", ".gitignore", "AGENTS.md", "docs/**"]
    relevance: the target files configure or document Terraform/OpenTofu state and repository artifact policy

  - name: environments_isolated_by_design
    description: |
      true when materially different environments/accounts and independently
      operated systems have separate state and deployment units whose boundaries
      contain failure and access. false when one mutable workspace or shared state
      is the primary isolation mechanism despite different lifecycles, privileges,
      or blast-radius needs.
    files:
      include: ["**/*.tf", "**/*.tf.json", "**/*.ts", "**/*.py", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.yml", "AGENTS.md", "docs/**"]
    relevance: the target files define or document multiple infrastructure environments, accounts, stacks, or deployment units

  - name: iac_locks_and_gate_reach_every_unit
    description: |
      true when each root module commits its own `.terraform.lock.hcl` — the
      documented exception to one-lockfile-per-ecosystem, since providers resolve
      per configuration — while any lint/scan/test harness written in another
      language keeps that ecosystem's single root lockfile; AND the gate reaches
      every deployment unit, with a repo-level `coverage` target that fails when a
      directory containing `*.tf` belongs to no project or a project skipped its
      format/validate/lint/scan checks. false when a lock file is uncommitted or
      hoisted, or when the split leaves some `*.tf` outside the gate so a full
      sweep silently became a partial one.
    files:
      include:
        - "**/.terraform.lock.hcl"
        - "**/*.tf"
        - "**/project.json"
        - "nx.json"
        - "justfile"
        - "Justfile"
        - ".justfile"
        - ".gitignore"
